western-sahara-minurso-2024-10-31.western-sahara-minurso-2024-10-31/pooled: Resolution 2756 (2024) was adopted by 12 votes in favor, zero against, and two abstentions (MAIN). Algeria proposed two amendments regarding OHCHR visits and MINURSO monitoring, which failed by 6–0–9 and 5–0–10 (AMEND). Algeria formally abstained from the final vote, citing disregard for its views on the Sahrawi people (DZ-B). Switzerland voted in favor of the resolution and abstained on the monitoring amendment to ensure mission continuity (CH-A). The adopted text authorized MINURSO until 31 October 2025 and urged cooperation with OHCHR without new monitoring functions (TEXT).
